      Tricky letters

      These six try to trick you, Cooper. Two questions catch them out every time.

      1. Which side is the ball on?

      2. Does the tail hang below the line?

      The bed trick

      b and d spell bed. The b is the headboard on the left, the d is the foot on the right — so a bed always points its balls inwards, towards the pillow.

      bed

      You already know one

      There is a p in the middle of your own name — and its ball is on the right, with its tail hanging down. Whenever you are stuck on a p, picture your name.
